title: Introducing the newly launched Nintendo eShop!
text:
Introducing the newly launched Nintendo eShop! | News & Updates | Nintendo November 10 2026 Nintendo Switch 2 Nintendo Switch Introducing the newly launched Nintendo eShop!
 As of November 10, 2026, the Nintendo eShop is available on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch. In this article, we are pleased to introduce the Nintendo eShop and highlight its key features and capabilities.
 The Nintendo eShop is an online store accessible directly from your Nintendo Switch 2 or Nintendo Switch system. Through an internet connection, users can purchase downloadable games, downloadable content, and more. 
 Please take a look at the video below.
 Introducing what you can do on the Nintendo eShop 
 Purchase and download a wide variety of digital content 
 By selecting Nintendo eShop from the HOME Menu on your Nintendo Switch 2 or Nintendo Switch console, you can access the Nintendo eShop and easily purchase digital games and downloadable content.
 Digital version 
 PREV NEXT 
 Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch offer two ways to enjoy your favorite games: physical and digital versions. Physical versions require inserting a physical game card into the console, while digital versions can be purchased and downloaded directly from the Nintendo eShop, no game card needed. Both versions contain the same game content.
 Digital games can be saved to the console's system memory, or on various storage media such as microSD Express cards for Nintendo Switch 2 or microSD cards for Nintendo Switch.
 Digital games 
 PREV NEXT 
 You can purchase digital games, which are not available in physical form. From major releases to indie games and free-to-play games, the Nintendo eShop offers a diverse lineup of content to suit every type of player.
 Downloadable content 
 PREV NEXT 
 You can purchase add-on content to expand your gameplay for any compatible games you own. Additional content may include new stages, characters, items, and more, offering new ways to enjoy the original game and enriching your overall experience.
 * Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack members who own Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, Animal Crossing: New Horizons, or Splatoon 2 can access paid DLC without any extra charges.
 Demos 
 PREV NEXT 
 If a game offers its demo version, you can try part of the game before making a purchase. Simply visit the product details page on the Nintendo eShop and select the Download Demo button to begin downloading. 
 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition Upgrade Pack 
 PREV NEXT 
 If you already own either the physical or digital version of a selected Nintendo Switch game, you can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition simply by purchasing the upgrade pack via the Nintendo eShop on your Nintendo Switch 2.
 For more details about Nintendo Switch 2 Edition games, please visit the official page .
 *Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack members who own The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild or The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom can use the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition at no additional charge.
 Nintendo eShop features 
 When you launch the Nintendo eShop, you'll first see the Highlights (Nintendo Switch 2 or Nintendo Switch) page. These areas are dedicated to showcasing featured games. The featured content is updated regularly, so be sure to check out.
 Search 
 Find games easily with search features on Nintendo eShop. Select “Search” from the Nintendo eShop menu to explore games by title, genre, or other criteria. You can narrow your search to include demo versions, games compatible with Nintendo Switch Online, and more, making it easy to discover games that match your interests.
 On Nintendo Switch 2, the Nintendo eShop offers enhanced search options that allow you to search for Nintendo Switch 2 games based on how you like to play. Use these features to make decisions when choosing your next game.
 For You (Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive feature) 
 By Selecting For You on the Nintendo Switch 2 eShop, you can view game suggestions tailored to your preferences. The more you explore the eShop, the better it gets at suggesting games that match your interests.
 *If you fully allow data sharing settings, more suitable content will be showcased. 
 https://accounts.nintendo.com/analytics/opt_in 
 Wish List 
 When you find a game you're interested in, you can press the ♥ icon on the product details page to add it to your Wish List. Once added to your Wish List, you can check the game anytime via the Nintendo eShop. 
 Ranking 
 The Ranking section of the Nintendo eShop showcases a selection of the most popular games, giving you a quick look at what’s trending among players. These Rankings are updated regularly, so be sure to check out.
 Additionally, the Nintendo eShop offers the latest information on new titles and discounted games. You can also complete your Nintendo Switch Online membership registration here. In addition to purchasing games, we encourage you to take advantage of useful features such as online play, GameChat, and Save Data Cloud backup. 
 Why not explore the Nintendo eShop and discover your next favorite game?
 *The screenshots shown are from a version of the Nintendo eShop in development and may not be final.
